benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your EazyDiner membership, check your email for the activation link and membership details. Visit the EazyDiner website or open the app, then register or log in using the details provided. Enter any promo or membership code you received to activate your benefits. Once activated, enjoy exclusive dining offers and priority reservations.
